story.speaker: Dat
story.title: Lan gap dau
story.quote: Anh nho anh sang hom do rat mem.
story.body: Mot buoi chieu binh thuong tro thanh moc bat dau cho tat ca nhung dieu khong binh thuong ve sau.

story.speaker: Duong
story.title: An tuong dau
story.quote: Co nguoi cuoi mot cai ma lam ngay dai hon.
story.body: Tu cach noi chuyen den nhung khoanh khac im lang, moi thu deu vua la vua quen.

story.speaker: Dat
story.title: Tin nhan dau
story.quote: Chi mot dong chu cung du lam tim dap nhanh.
story.body: Nhung tin nhan ngan dan thanh thoi quen, thanh niem vui moi sang va loi chuc ngu ngon moi toi.

story.speaker: Duong
story.title: Hen ho dau
story.quote: Thanh pho on ao, nhung minh nghe ro nhau.
story.body: Quan nho, hai ly nuoc, va mot loi hua se con gap lai that nhieu lan nua.

timeline.title: Ngay bat dau
timeline.text: Mot diem cham dau tien tren ban do ky niem.

timeline.title: Buoi hen dau
timeline.text: Cafe, anh mat, va cau chuyen ke mai khong het.

timeline.title: Da Lat
timeline.text: Ba ngay hai dem lac giua suong mu va tieng cuoi.

timeline.title: Mot nam
timeline.text: Mot vong trai dat nho xiu quay quanh hai trai tim.

letters.title: Gui anh
letters.text: Cam on anh vi da den, o lai, va lam nhung ngay binh thuong tro nen lap lanh.

letters.title: Gui em
letters.text: Anh thich cach em bien moi noi minh di qua thanh mot noi dang nho.

letters.title: Loi hua
letters.text: Minh cu di cham thoi, mien la van di cung nhau qua moi mua.

locations.name: Da Lat
locations.text: Sang som lanh va tay nam chat.

locations.name: Bai bien
locations.text: Gio bien cat giu mot loi hua.

tracks.title: Perfect
tracks.reason: Bai hat cho nhung buoi toi di ve cham.

tracks.title: La Vie En Rose
tracks.reason: Khi moi thu nhin qua lang kinh mau hong.

tracks.title: Until I Found You
tracks.reason: Nhu mot loi ke chuyen that nhe.
